results.title: Gunmen open fire at a church during a funeral in Jordan, killing 7 and wounding 34 others
results.description: JERUSALEM (AP) — Gunmen opened fire during a funeral at a church in Jordan on Friday, killing seven people and wounding 34 others, authorities said.

results.description: JANESVILLE – The Rock County Board approved appointees for a new, 13-member panel that would help guide the county and towns’ response to data center developments, despite some county supervisors decrying county board Chairman Kevin Levy’s picks for the panel…

results.title: Birdwatching rewires the brain and slows cognitive decline
results.description: Birdwatching can help slow brain ageing and is increasingly being used as therapy for dementia patients.

results.title: Billions spent abroad as patients question care at home
results.description: From unreliable diagnoses to rushed consultations and higher treatment costs, patients explain why they seek care abroad, while doctors warn that commercial interests are also driving the exodus Details

results.title: Iron Maiden Drummer Nicko McBrain Declares Trump Should Be Imprisoned, Amid 50th‑Year Tour
results.description: Nicko McBrain, famed drummer of heavy‑metal icon Iron Maiden, publicly denounced former President Donald Trump, refusing to play golf with him and urging legal action. The 74‑year‑old drummer shared his political grievances while the band celebrates its 50th anniversary tour and Hall of Fame induction, highlighting the evolving role of musicians in political discourse.

results.title: Toddler, two others found shot dead after mysterious 911 call for 'help'
results.description: Deputies in Ohio are investigating a mysterious 911 call that led to the discovery of three bodies – including a toddler – who had been shot.
